parishServedBySource: Worked out from the 8 polyclinic catchment polygons (Barbados_Polyclinics.shp, as used in Health forms/ehd3 CATCHMENTS): a polyclinic serves a parish when at least 3 GeoNames places in that parish fall inside its catchment. Team decision 15 Oct 2026: these catchment polygons are the person catchment.

eunice-gibson.name: Eunice Gibson catchment
eunice-gibson.servesText: It serves people who live in an area covering parts of St. Thomas, St. Michael, St. James, St. Andrew and St. Joseph. Places in this area include Warrens, Welchman Hall, Rock Hall (St. Thomas), Redmans, Hopewell, Bagatelle, Apes Hill, Jackmans, Lodge Hill and Hillaby.

placesSource: GeoNames BB dump (CC-BY 4.0, download.geonames.org, fetched 12 Oct 2026): populated places, localities and estates, with parish from admin1 code; plus version one's 36 hand-checked villages.
